author: dberweger2017
body:
Owner-approved follow-up: verify retained HU20 recovery, then measure HU100 growth

The owner explicitly approved these next steps in chat on October 8 and asked that this approval be recorded here. The 5.5-GiB stop occurred in the Python verification process, not native training (which peaked around 1.56 GiB aggregate). Preserve the original campaign's terminal result and all failure evidence; this is an authorized, separately recorded follow-up.

1. Raise the hard aggregate RSS ceiling to **10 GiB for the entire owned job family**, for both verification and subsequent HU100 work. This is a ceiling, not a target. Admit only on the genuinely free 16-GB M4 with sufficient current system headroom and AC power; never stop or modify another worker. Keep the **0.5-GiB swap-growth limit** and **15.5-GiB free-disk floor**. Record system memory pressure as well as process-family RSS; stop on unsafe system pressure even below 10 GiB. Run heavy verification sequentially. Recalculate the controlled-stop/save threshold from measured serialization needs so training leaves room for a valid checkpoint below the hard cap.

2. Make **one fresh, guarded verification attempt using the already retained reference/recovery checkpoints and exports**, after verifying their hashes and provenance. Do not repeat passed reference training or retrain the resumed endpoint. Complete the full-state IEEE comparison, both export audits and exact average-policy comparison with only the declared recovery metadata differences allowed. Memory-efficiency improvements to the verifier are authorized if needed; preserve scientific checks and record/review any changed verifier source separately from the original executed training source/binary. A second resource stop or any correctness mismatch stops dependent work and requires a report, not automatic retries or further limit increases.

3. **Only after full HU20 recovery equivalence passes**, proceed with the planned fresh HU100 pilot and table-growth run under the revised envelope: unchanged linear CFR/opponent-sampled recipe, seed and abstraction/menu; early checkpoints at 100k/1M/5M/10M, then every 1B up to **10B total nodes**. Audit the pilot and retain measured admission forecasts. A controlled training-capacity stop is a valid experimental outcome. Preserve continuous samples and checkpoint-level RAM, swap, entries/growth, throughput, save size/time and street/average-mass diagnostics. Clearly distinguish verified checkpoints from merely completed saves.

4. Retain the owner's already recorded **October 8, 12:00 Europe/Madrid hard deadline**. This approval does not reset or extend that clock. Reserve sufficient remaining time for saves, exports and audits; do not start a stage that cannot fit. During active work use at most one lightweight **30-minute T3 status check**, with durable duplicate-launch protection; disable it on completion, a terminal stop or the deadline. Continuous worker guards enforce limits independently of agent wake-ups.

5. Update this PR's protocol, report and body with the new authorization, separate attempt receipts and actual outcome. Archive new evidence with manifests/retrieval provenance under repository policy, retaining originals and prior failures. Obtain independent review and green CI for changes. No paid compute, arena, release, automatic merge, artifact cleanup or work beyond the deadline is authorized by this amendment.

This explicitly supersedes the earlier no-retry/no-limit-increase instruction only for the bounded follow-up above. No further owner confirmation is needed to execute these steps within this envelope.
